model_output.verdict: A senior payments engineer whose resume connects production changes to measurable results.
write_up: This is a strong senior backend resume! At Lumen Ledger, you show payments work from service design through ledger migration and production reliability, with numbers that make the work concrete. A recruiter can see why you fit a money movement role.

The balance API line is a great model: it names the change, the technical approach, and the latency before and after. Your mentoring and incident reviews also show how you contribute beyond building services.

For Cobalt Pay, bring your on-call responsibilities into the Lumen Ledger role if you held them. Add any work with Finance and Risk on reconciliation and controls, or technical design reviews you led, if those were part of your job. The resume itself is unlikely to be the main obstacle; the match on those responsibilities and competition for the role also matter.
